raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Hanggin (Hangjin) Rear Banner figure “20.87” from the hjhq.gov.cn source as 20.87 million instead of 20.87万人 (~208,700), and also incorrectly treated Shanghai’s 14.8017 million (household-registered population) as its permanent resident total, ignoring the cited 24.8745 million permanent residents for 2023. These two misreadings led to the wrong conclusion that Hanggin Rear Banner has a larger population than Shanghai.
